clips.start_words: I want to be a trust fund kid
clips.end_words: I manifested that using my mind
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says he got tired of trading hours for a paycheck, so he set one goal: never work another day in his life. He didn't ask the universe how - he just named the result and used the technique he still teaches.

Out of nowhere, a man named Arthur Schiff called. He was producing a commercial for a knife and needed someone to write it.

Kevin wrote the ad in a day. That knife became the Ginsu. The royalty checks started within months and kept coming for the next fifteen years - some of them, he says, still arrive today.

What is one result you would name right now, without knowing how it happens?

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #lawofattraction #yourwishisyourcommand #mindset #success
clips.send: A 9-to-5 friend sends it to another friend stuck trading hours for a paycheck, in awe that one ad paid him for 15 years without a plan.
